dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The 3-5 most prominent 'O' and 'C' structures exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters with a sharp, high-contrast gradient transition from the dark fur field to white/cream interior rings, particularly concentrated along the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters appearing as small punctate spots, primarily distributed in the interstitial spaces between the larger macro-annuli and towards the anterior dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary mid-lateral macro-annuli form a series of interconnected scalene triangles, creating a non-linear geometric network that follows the curvature of the dorsal-lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A specific nested topology is observed where high-intensity core blobs are centrally positioned within larger, circular macro-annuli, creating a 'target' appearance in the mid-body region.
